description: Standard values per heat source type (SUSI P1). Used when a house profile's heat_source sets no efficiency / fuel_price. Efficiency = seasonal performance factor (JAZ) for heat pumps, annual efficiency (Nutzungsgrad) otherwise; no age dependency.

sources.efficiency: Heat pumps luft / erde: Earnie defaults before SUSI P1 (unchanged); grundwasser and boilers: SUSI hinterlegteWerte.json, new device (Energieinstitut Vorarlberg); electric_direct: Heizrechner v5.0 Stromheizung.
sources.energy_content: SUSI hinterlegteWerte.json (oil 10 kWh/l, pellets 4,900 kWh/t, wood 1,800 kWh/rm).
sources.fuel_price: Heizrechner v5.0 defaults (Energieinstitut Vorarlberg), as of 2022 — outdated, refresh before release.
sources.co2_g_per_kwh: Hexit / Replace data.js (Energieinstitut Vorarlberg); wood: Heizrechner v5.0 Stückholz.
